material.description:
scenarios/moba/assets/icons/abilities has 65 png (arcane_lift..hurricane, generic names); abilities_688g_b01..b12.osd carry ~250 learnable abilities; 6.88g ability ids (A0NR etc.) have no icon mapping.
Acceptance: An ability->icon map covers every ability id or lists the gap; missing icons render the name text rather than being requested (matches 170627de behavior).
Witness route: Filename scan: icon per ability id, gaps listed in one tsv.
